defects.note: Owner-reported: the process list refresh rendering diverges badly from the Store build. Triptych captures feed the fix.

Found by the remediation validation suite: after a live non-admin scan the Issues page renders only 3 of the 8 maintenance rows (Restart as administrator / Clean temp files / Open Device Manager). Repair-tier rows (SFC, DISM) and the service-restart rows are never realized in the UIA tree even after scrolling — the Repair confirmation gate is therefore untestable as a standard user. Expected: all 8 canonical maintenance rows render (admin rows marked, execution gated by elevation).
First harness run exposed the graceful-close deadlock (worker Drop joined before releasing the command sender); fixed in commit 701648f and re-validated.
